svg.title: Context degrades in five distinct patterns that each need a different fix.
svg.desc: Five degradation patterns: position loss, where present evidence is used inconsistently by its position in the sequence; poisoning, where a stale or malicious item shapes later decisions; distraction, where similar noise crowds out relevant evidence; confusion, where overlapping items leave several plausible readings; and clash, where two authoritative-looking items disagree without exposed precedence.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Context degrades in five distinct patterns

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Byte lost a fix to a stale doc that poisoned every later decision.
